Roland keeps trying to remember, yet all he can recall is that he was not picked as the main character—he might have been a talented child actor, but he never could become the lead.
Maybe he still cannot be. No one considers him someone worth paying attention to. But why should he care?
Even without a script or rehearsals, the moment an actor steps onto the stage... he must embody his role.
